items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I know you had Tommy Anastasis and Frank Hipner and people like that. ... Yeah, Hipner was a very -- truly outstanding jazz player

ctx.x: Are there other outstanding baritone players in your band? I know you had Tommy Anastasis and Frank Hipner and people like that.
Yeah, Hipner was a very -- truly outstanding jazz player, but he was a kind of a strange young man, and he still resides, I think, in Reno.
